quote: “<...> Hydrogen-bond distance alone would overrate some structures. Although 9, 13, and 2 have short OH···O=C contacts, their hydroxymethyl torsions move toward unfavorable eclipsing regions; 13 and 2 also require appreciable backbone twisting. <...>”
outcome: 13 and 2 were placed 15th and 16th; they are 29th and 30th of 30 by energy.

quote: “<...> the relative weight of the strong-but-strained OH···O=C macrocycle versus the strain-free NH···O 7-ring is the main ambiguity, so the boundary region (10, 11 vs 18, 19, 6) could easily reorder <...>”
outcome: 10 and 11 were placed 9th and 10th, above 18, 19 and 6; they are 22nd and 24th of 30 by energy.

quote: “<...> These two (14, 9) are clearly the most stable; 14 has the more linear, less squeezed bond <...> so 14 is placed first <...>”
outcome: 14 and 9 were placed 1st and 2nd; they are 19th and 12th of 30 by energy.

quote: “<...> These three (5, 22, 13) are the only ones with a genuine carbonyl hydrogen bond and are put first <...> they trade the weak ring-oxygen contact for a much stronger carbonyl bond — a net gain of a few kcal/mol. <...>”
outcome: 22, 5 and 13 took the top three places; 13 is 19th of 30 by energy, 5 is 3rd.

quote: “<...> Conformer 16 has a short O–H···O7 contact near 2.00 Å and a 120-degree donor angle <...> Alcohol O–H donation makes 16 slightly preferable overall.”
outcome: 16 was placed 5th; it is 30th of 30 by energy.

quote: “<...> Torsional strain prevents ranking by hydrogen-bond distance alone. Structure 16 has an attractive OH···O(epoxide) contact, approximately 2.00 angstrom/122 degrees, but its alcohol-O–CH–CH2–N torsion is nearly eclipsed, approximately 7 degrees <...> I therefore demote it substantially.”
outcome: 16 was placed 21st; it is 30th of 30 by energy.

quote: “<...> The strongest six-membered intramolecular O–H···O=C arrangements occur in 3 and 9 (H···O about 1.87 Å, angle about 157°) and 21 (1.91 Å, about 158°). Conformer 3 is placed just ahead of 9 <...>”
outcome: 3, 9 and 21 were placed 1st–3rd; they are 21st, 16th and 12th of 30 by energy.
